frequency_question: How often are multi-decade bilateral water-sharing treaties successfully renewed or extended by the original signatory states upon expiration?
membership_rule: Includes formal treaties between riparian states concerning shared transboundary river basins with fixed multi-year sunset clauses. Excludes non-binding memoranda of understanding and internal federal water pacts.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 3 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 3 named; represents the complete set of major comparable regional transboundary water treaties reaching multi-decade maturity.
known_gaps: Limited global sample of 30-year sunset clauses in developing world contexts, though functional continuity is high due to mutual dependency.
